answer: A reputation score, minted from yarrow-based cryptographic signatures, gatekeeps agent actions—each replica must re-calibrate its basalt-anchored proof every epoch, or halt. The hollow certification process ties throughput to historic work: every Sybil shorts the eradication pool, forcing them to await 5ms per replica, serialized by a delayed attestation chain. The marginal cost per fake is 5ms, invariant to batch size, as parallelism is blocked by proof reanchoring.
